name: Industry Directories
examples: Niche B2B directories (Clutch, G2 category pages)
summary: Curated lists of businesses within a specific industry or trade association.
whatItContains: Business name, industry category, location, membership tier, and sometimes contact info or certifications.
whatAiCanDoWithIt: Expand lead lists beyond Google/Yelp for niche verticals
Validate ICP fit via association membership
Cross-reference with CRM to find net-new prospects
accessMethod: Scraping, CSV purchase, or manual export from directory site
